summary: The linked contracts passed the complete repository suite, repeated builds were byte-identical, and the real CLI produced a checksum-verifiable result bundle without changing the v0.1 runtime.

guardrails.detail: All pre-existing tests passed and no campaign, optimizer, participant, or release module changed.

findings.label: Deterministic publication record
findings.description: The same manifests generate byte-identical JSON, Markdown, and checksum files while preserving exact source revisions.

findings.label: Contract scope only
findings.description: The proof validates research-record plumbing; it provides no evidence yet about PEFT, offload, partial-model, or tiled-training effectiveness.

limitations: The fixture proves local research-record generation only; remote publication and multi-campaign study comparison remain future integration work.
